draft.subject: Next step after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week — good to talk through how Bright Partners is setting things up. You've got your first project created and an invite out, which is the right start: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting real work into that project rather than a placeholder.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first batch of work with you.

Best,
Nadia
